title: Ridgeline Special Order Services Customer Cancellation Terms and Cancellation Fee
content:
**1. When the customer may cancel.** The customer may cancel a Ridgeline Special Order Services order whose status is placed or vendor confirmed, by their own confirmation, recorded first as a cancellation request on the order. Once production has started or the item has shipped, the customer may not cancel where the program is not cancellable after production starts, except under the vendor-delay remedy.

**2. Free cancellation window.** A cancellation made within the program's free cancellation window, in hours after the moment the order was placed, carries no fee. The hours are full 60-minute periods counted from the moment the order was placed; a cancellation at exactly that many hours still qualifies.

**3. Cancellation fee.** A later cancellation carries a fee of the program's cancellation fee percentage of the order total, rounded to the cent and never less than the program's minimum cancellation fee, posted as a cancellation fee.

**4. No fee.** No fee applies when the program allows free cancellation on a vendor change and the vendor changed the price, specification or lead time after the order, or when the cancellation is made by the system for lack of vendor confirmation or supply.

**5. Settlement.** On every cancellation the order total is reversed by an order cancellation credit, and the net amount paid on the order — the payments received less the refunds already issued — less the fee is refunded under the Ridgeline Special Order Services refund terms, never below zero.

## Window boundary (hypothetical Semi-Custom Cabinetry order with a 72-hour window, placed 4 May at 09:00)

| Cancellation confirmed | Full hours since placement | Fee |
|---|---|---|
| 7 May at 09:00 | 72 | none |
| 7 May at 10:00 | 73 | percentage fee applies |

## Fee and refund figures (hypothetical orders)

| Program and order | Fee | Net paid | Refund |
|---|---|---|---|
| Semi-Custom Cabinetry, order total 1800.00, after the window | 25 percent is 450.00, above the 250.00 minimum: 450.00 | 900.00 | 450.00 |
| Catalog Merchandise, order total 60.00, after the window | 15 percent is 9.00, below the 25.00 minimum: 25.00 | 60.00 | 35.00 |
| Made-to-Measure Window Coverings, order total 300.00, after the window | 100 percent: 300.00 | 300.00 | 0.00 |
| any program, vendor changed the lead time after the order | none | 500.00 | 500.00 |

## Points of judgement

- The window runs from the moment the order was placed, not from the start of the order date.
- A cancellation for lack of vendor confirmation or supply is made by the system and carries no fee.
- An order in production or shipped is not cancelled at the customer's request outside the vendor-delay remedy.
